A small fix to the diary's energy numbers. Install it over 1.0.3; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.4/Spectra.apk)**

### Fixed
- **Surplus and Over target could differ by 1 kcal** when burned and your target showed the same number. Burned is now counted in whole calories, the same way the target is, so the numbers on the Energy card always add up.
